characters.prompt:
Create exactly 80 whole-body poses of the SINGLE character in the official design reference. Transparent background. Regular grid 8 columns by 10 rows, generous transparent separation, no text, no labels, no floor/shadows, ears/tail/feet never clipped. Same body proportions and scale across all cells. Flat 2D anime drawings, no plush/no 3D. Never draw human hands, bowls, cushions, furniture. Directions E SE S SW W NW N NE clockwise screen directions.
Row1 standing 8 directions; Row2 walking step A same 8 directions; Row3 walking step B same directions.
Row4 happy front, eating with spoon actor-only, lying asleep, annoyed, sulking, startled, carried without hand, playful crouch.
Row5 front neutral, blink, sleepy sitting, sitting eyes closed, self-groom A/B, stretch A/B.
Row6 seated self-hug A/B, seated looking up A/B, neutral front, pleased head touch NO HUMAN HAND, pleased chin touch NO HAND, proud.
Row7 cheek mild/medium/strong discomfort WITHOUT deforming cheeks, soothed, playful crouch A, play upright B, poked reaction NO HAND, shy.
Row8 seated front, seated aside, lying sleeping A/B, meal spoon raised/lowered WITHOUT BOWL, DRINKING WATER leaning toward ground lips forward A then licking lip B: NO SPOON NO CHOPSTICKS NO CUP NO FOOD IN THESE LAST TWO CELLS.
Row9 cookie A/B, strawberry cake with SPOON A/B, candy A/B, dorayaki A/B.
Row10 pudding with SPOON A/B, beer can A/B, forehead flick mild/strong reaction NO HAND, front neutral, rear neutral.
Only own rounded paws hold food/utensils. Each cell full silhouette separated by clear alpha, 8 poses EVERY row. Canonical identity from supplied official reference, no other character.
My Melody: white rabbit body, pale pink hood, ONE ear flopped sideways, one upright/flopped at top, sky-blue flower/bow on hood at left, warm tan outlines/oval eyes/yellow oval nose, small white round tail. Hood extends as pink collar. Preserve official asymmetrical ears; no human clothes.
characters.foodPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent game ACTOR-ONLY sprite atlas. Create exactly 24 separate full-body front-facing eating poses of the SAME character from the reference, 4 columns x 6 rows, generous transparent gutters. Match reference anatomy, body/head proportions, linework and flat colors precisely; original 2D manga style. All 24 poses share EXACT same head/body size, sitting stance, foot baseline and camera. A placed bowl will be composited by software beneath this actor, therefore draw NO bowl, plate, cup, furniture, human hand, text or background. Character never carries a bowl. Character's own paws/claws hold utensils, never human hands. Utensils reach into empty space just ahead of the feet where the software bowl rim will sit. 
Row1 columns1-2 white rice chopsticks: A hand lowers two parallel wooden chopsticks into empty bowl space at feet; B lifts small WHITE rice bite toward mouth. Columns3-4 furikake rice chopsticks: A lowers chopsticks; B brings white rice bite with tiny green seaweed flakes to mouth, satisfied.
Row2 columns1-2 curry rice spoon: A lowers lavender spoon into empty bowl space at feet; B raises small golden curry rice spoonful to mouth. Columns3-4 jiro ramen: A own paw holds two wooden chopsticks down toward bowl space; B lifts a SHORT bundle of yellow noodles from that space toward open mouth, no drawn container.
Row3 columns1-2 nuts: A picks a small brown nut from empty bowl space with own paw/claw; B nibbles it. Columns3-4 fruit: A picks a tiny apple slice from empty bowl space with own paw/claw; B nibbles it.
Only food bites attach to utensils or paws, no disconnected floating particles. Transparent alpha. Entire silhouette including ears, tail and utensils fits cell. No new costume, no body squashing, no human fingers. Retain the character identity from reference, do not invent a generic animal.
ADDITIONAL ROWS EXACTLY: Row4 cookie own paw A/B, strawberry cake bite on SPOON A/B. Row5 special pink wrapped candy own paw A/B, dorayaki sandwich own paws A/B. Row6 small pudding on SPOON A/B, small beer can held in own paw A/B. These last 12 are snack actions, may hold tiny dessert/cake/pudding/can but NO MEAL BOWL. Earlier rows1-3 strictly no container. Keep same seated body stance, dimensions throughout. Single character mymelody exactly as official reference. No 3D, no human hand.

spoonless.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the referenced 4x4 transparent bowl atlas. REMOVE EVERY REAL SPOON from the thirteen food/empty food-bowl sprites. Remove entire spoon handle and spoon head and reconstruct food or bowl rim behind it. Keep all bowl artwork, bear emblem, lavender colors, food quantities, outlines, image size and each bowl position EXACTLY unchanged. No new utensils, no engravings, no spoons anywhere. Keep bottom row water bowls unchanged. Do not move, resize or reshape any bowl. Keep the 4x4 cell order: white rice full/half, furikake full/half; curry full/half, jiro ramen full/half; nuts full/half, fruit full/half; empty bear food bowl, full plain water bowl, half water bowl, empty water bowl. Same shell size and foot baseline within every cell. Transparent alpha.

furniture.prompt: Transparent game furniture sprite sheet, exactly 4 isolated objects in regular 2 columns by 2 rows, generous gaps, NO text NO characters NO background shadows. Match gentle pastel lavender desktop pet app icons, simple clean dark ink and flat anime shading, naturally round proportions, no vertical squash. Top left: playful lavender and mint striped rubber ball. Top right: soft tiny cream teddy bear doll seated, small blue bow, brown embroidered eyes. Bottom left: lavender beanbag chair, plump rounded soft fabric with visible seams and depressed seat open to sit on, pale blue interior. Bottom right: cozy woven straw nest bowl, oval rim with little cream fluffy lining, open center to lie inside. Each object a standalone natural aspect ratio silhouette fully inside its cell. No paw print, no human hands. Same nominal visual width for both beds.
